messages:
Jordan (Enablement): hey team :wave: we need to lock the host rota for the week of Apr 8 — we promised extra APAC-friendly evening slots for a set of onboarding customers. can folks mark availability and capacity?
Michelle (CS): I can host Mon/Tue 6–8pm SGT. capacity ~12 seats, prefer hands-on lab format.
Sam (Solutions): Tue works for me if Michelle wants the walkthrough slot. I can co-host Tue for product Q&A.
Kei (APAC CS): Thu 7–9pm JST is rough but i can cover Thu 7–8pm. i’ll also handle a Japan-language breakout if needed.
Jordan (Enablement): perfect. i'll post the tentative calendar invite once we agree. quick notes: recordings will be on, but we should mute recordings during live customer debug sessions. also capture churn/renewal signals in post-session notes.
Ana (Customer): FYI two of our trial customers (HelixThera, NovaHealth) asked specifically for evening slots. they’re likely to attend Tue/Thu.
Jordan (Enablement): thanks Ana — can you DM the account reps to flag renewal-risk customers so we prioritize canary slots?
Ana (Customer): will do.
Michelle (CS): proposed agenda (short):
```
18:00 - 18:10 intro + goals
18:10 - 18:40 hands-on lab (guided template)
18:40 - 19:00 open Q&A + next steps
```
I can tweak for Tue to add a short migration checklist.
Sam (Solutions): add a 5-min note on Dedicated capacity and common gotchas for session Tuesday.
Jordan (Enablement): good call. also need someone to own the feedback capture form for each session — want a single google form we attach to calendar?
Kevin (Platform): i can create a short form and webhook it to the CS-ops board. will include fields: account, session attended, net action (ontrack/at-risk), follow-up owner.
Jordan (Enablement): awesome. can you do that today?
Kevin (Platform): yes — will post link when done.
DeployBot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/enablement-evening-sprint-2024-04-08 (owner: Jordan).
Jordan (Enablement): posted. please RSVP and add any notes in the event description. i’ll assign leads: Mon — Michelle (lead), Tue — Michelle + Sam, Thu — Kei (lead), fallback Fri — Jordan.
Michelle (CS): noted. who’s taking meeting notes for Tue? i can grab the first half, need someone to own actionable items.
Sam (Solutions): I’ll own action items for Tue.
Jordan (Enablement): thanks — responsibilities:
- host/run: Michelle (Mon), Michelle+Sam (Tue), Kei (Thu)
- notes & follow-ups: Sam (Tue), Jordan (Fri fallback)
- feedback form & automation: Kevin
- recordings & transcript publish: Michelle will toggle recording, Kevin will publish transcript to the CS drive.
Kei (APAC CS): thumbs up. can we add a short pre-session checklist to the calendar description? like model-version, API keys, sample prompt.
Jordan (Enablement): yes — put this snippet in the description:
```
Pre-session checklist:
- pin model version in Redwood Console
- enable dedicated session token for demos
- sample prompt file: /drive/enablement/samples/evening-lab.txt
```
Sam (Solutions): small ask — can we reserve 2 extra seats for overflow? some accounts like NovaHealth invite 3–4 engineers.
Michelle (CS): we can bump capacity to 15 for Tue, still comfortable.
Kevin (Platform): feedback form ready: https://forms.redwood.ai/enablement-evening-feedback — webhook integrated to CS-ops board.
Jordan (Enablement): perfect. final checklist before I send final invites: everyone confirm availability stamps in the event and add any language breakout needs. also if anyone spots a customer flagged with renewal risk please ping me and Ana so we can prioritize a follow-up workshop.
Ana (Customer): flagged HelixThera as medium risk, will DM Jordan and Michelle with context.
Michelle (CS): confirmed. i’ll prepare the migration checklist and slide handoff.
Sam (Solutions): confirmed for Tue + will prep Dedicated troubleshooting slides.
Kei (APAC CS): confirmed for Thu 7–8pm JST.
Jordan (Enablement): lovely — i’ll send the final schedule and add a short post-session feedback cadence: 24h reminder to reps to file notes + 72h renewal-risk triage if any red flags show up. thanks team :rocket:
